import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def power(a, b):
    ans = 1
    while b:
        ans = (ans * a) % MOD
        b -= 1
    return ans

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    if k == 0:
        print(power(p, p - 1))
    elif k == 1:
        print(power(p, p))
    else:
        ord_val = 1
        cur = k % p
        while cur != 1:
            cur = (cur * k) % p
            ord_val += 1
        print(power(p, (p - 1) // ord_val))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
